associated_conditions: Hereditary Breast and Ovarian Cancer Syndrome
molecular_mechanism: Encodes a nuclear phosphoprotein maintaining genomic stability through homologous recombination DNA double-strand break repair.
acmg_classification_guidance: PVS1 null variants in known biologically active regions indicate high risk. Genetic counseling required.
clinical_implications: Carriers benefit from enhanced MRI surveillance from age 25 and risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy between ages 35-40.

associated_conditions: Congenital Bilateral Absence of the Vas Deferens (CBAVD)
molecular_mechanism: ATP-binding cassette transporter acting as a cAMP-regulated chloride and bicarbonate channel across epithelial membranes.
acmg_classification_guidance: c.1521_1523delCTT (p.Phe508del) represents the most common pathogenic mutation in Class II processing defects.
clinical_implications: Targeted CFTR modulators (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor) restore channel gating and trafficking for eligible genotypes.

molecular_mechanism: Essential component of chylomicrons and VLDL that mediates lipoprotein clearance via hepatic LDL receptors; isoform epsilon-4 reduces amyloid-beta clearance.
acmg_classification_guidance: APOE epsilon 4 is a susceptibility allele, NOT a deterministic diagnostic mutation. High penetrance modifier.
clinical_implications: APOE e4 homozygotes have increased risk of ARIA (amyloid-related imaging abnormalities) when treated with anti-amyloid monoclonal antibodies.

molecular_mechanism: Cell surface receptor binding ApoB-100 and ApoE to mediate endocytosis of cholesterol-rich LDL particles.
acmg_classification_guidance: Loss-of-function variants cause premature atherosclerosis and tendon xanthomas with untreated LDL-C > 190 mg/dL.
clinical_implications: Requires aggressive lifelong lipid-lowering therapy starting in childhood to prevent early myocardial infarction.
